posts.text:
aries aura report

started a fight with the self-checkout: -1000 aura
won the fight with the self-checkout: +5000 aura
forgot it happened 4 minutes later: +infinite aura

the self-checkout is still thinking about it
posts.caption: Aries is ruled by Mars, so they go to war fast and let it go even faster. The grudge never lasts, but the legend does. What is the pettiest thing you have seen an Aries argue with?

posts.text:
pov: you told an aries "bet you can't"

it's 2am. they learned the entire skill. they're doing it in the parking lot. they're making you watch.

you did this. you have no one to blame
posts.caption: Aries is the most competitive sign in the zodiac, and a dare works on them like a starting pistol. They will not sleep until they have proven you wrong. What is the last thing you dared an Aries to do?

posts.text:
aries crash out speedrun

0:00 someone walks slow in front of them
0:03 full crash out
0:08 apologizing
0:09 best friends with the slow walker

world record. nobody asked
posts.caption: Aries has the shortest fuse and the shortest memory in the zodiac, which is honestly a great combo. The anger burns hot, then it is gone and they have a new friend. How fast does your Aries cool off?

posts.text:
aries rizz tier list

s tier: challenging you to a race on the first date
a tier: winning the race
b tier: saying "good game" like they mean it
f tier: waiting 3 days to text back (physically cannot)
posts.caption: Aries flirts through competition, so a first date is basically a tournament. They are bold, direct and incapable of playing hard to get. Would you race an Aries on the first date?

posts.text:
chat is this real

a taurus just said "i'm down for anything"

then rejected 14 restaurants

we're getting the usual. we were always getting the usual
posts.caption: Taurus is a fixed earth sign ruled by Venus, which means comfort food is not a preference, it is a lifestyle. They say they are flexible, but the bull already has a booth picked out. What is your Taurus's usual order?

posts.text:
taurus lore drop

has owned the same hoodie since 2019
named it
would fight you for it
has never once fought anyone

the hoodie is the only exception. do not touch the hoodie
posts.caption: Taurus loves texture, comfort and things that last, so their favorite clothes become family heirlooms. They are famously chill until you mess with what is theirs. What item would your Taurus never give up?

posts.text:
venus in taurus is cooked

said "no spending this month"
bought a $60 blanket on day 2
called it "an investment in my peace"

locked in on the vibes. not on the budget
posts.caption: Venus is at home in Taurus, so these placements cannot resist anything soft, cozy or expensive feeling. The budget had good intentions, the blanket had better ones. What is your Venus in Taurus impulse buy?

posts.text:
taurus aura scoring

leaving the party early to go eat: +2000 aura
not moving for 6 hours: +3000 aura
asking them to walk faster: -1000 aura (for you)

the bull does not do cardio
posts.caption: Taurus energy is grounded, patient and deeply committed to rest, and they will not be rushed by anyone. Peace and snacks are the whole strategy. Have you ever tried to hurry a Taurus?

posts.text:
chat is this real

a gemini just explained their whole new personality

it's tuesday

they had a different one on monday

both are valid and they're debating each other in the group chat at 1am
posts.caption: Gemini is the sign of the twins, ruled by Mercury, so their mind is always running two conversations at once. Reinvention is not a crisis for them, it is a hobby. How many eras has your Gemini had this year?

posts.text:
gemini lore drop

47 hobbies started
2 hobbies finished
1 hobby was reading about other people's hobbies

still the most interesting person you know. it's the side quests
posts.caption: Gemini is a mutable air sign with endless curiosity, so they collect skills like browser tabs. They rarely finish, but they always have a story. What is your most abandoned hobby?

posts.text:
pov: you're dating a gemini

day 1: obsessed with you
day 2: obsessed with medieval bread
day 3: obsessed with you again but now they know about bread

this is the deal. accept the bread lore
posts.caption: Dating a Gemini means you get their full attention, just with frequent detours into a new obsession. Mercury keeps them curious, and they always come back with fun facts. What random topic has your Gemini taught you about?

posts.text:
gemini rising has entered the chat

knows everyone at the party
knows nobody's last name
has 6 inside jokes with the bartender

npc? never. main character with 400 side characters
posts.caption: A Gemini rising meets the world with quick wit and instant chemistry, so every room becomes their group chat. They connect fast and keep it light. Are you the Gemini rising who knows everyone?

posts.text:
cancer crash out stages

1) "i'm fine"
2) cleaning the whole kitchen
3) looking at old photos
4) making soup for everyone who upset them

that's not a crash out. that's a love language
posts.caption: Cancer is a cardinal water sign ruled by the moon, so even their meltdowns come out nurturing. They process feelings by taking care of everyone else first. What does your Cancer cook when they are upset?

posts.text:
cancer moon aura points

remembering your coffee order from 2021: +3000 aura
crying at a dog food ad: -200 aura
crying at a dog food ad in public: +1000 aura (we respect the commitment)
posts.caption: The moon is at home in Cancer, which gives these placements a perfect emotional memory and zero shame about feeling things. Sensitivity is their superpower, not a weakness. What ad has made you cry?

posts.text:
pov: a cancer adopted you

you said you were hungry one (1) time

now you have a container of pasta, a blanket, and a seat at their family's thanksgiving

no you cannot leave. this is your lore now
posts.caption: Cancer suns are the zodiac's caretakers, and once they decide you are family, it is permanent. Expect leftovers, check-in texts and a standing holiday invite. Has a Cancer ever adopted you like this?

posts.text:
cancer sun is cooked

the situationship ended 3 months ago

they still have the receipt from the first date
in a box
labeled

chat is this healing? (no. but it's organized)
posts.caption: Cancer is the most sentimental sign in the zodiac, so every memory gets archived with care. Letting go takes time, and they will keep the evidence until they are ready. What sentimental thing are you still holding on to?

posts.text:
leo aura farming checklist

find the best lighting: done
laugh slightly louder than the joke: done
walk in 10 minutes late on purpose: done

peak aura farming. no notes. their ruling planet is literally the sun
posts.caption: Leo is ruled by the sun, so standing in the spotlight is basically a biological need. Their main character energy is warm, generous and a little bit planned. Have you ever caught a Leo farming aura?

posts.text:
leo rizz tier list

s tier: hyping you up in public like a sports announcer
a tier: making you a playlist
b tier: the playlist is 60% their own voice memos
f tier: being humble (never seen it)
posts.caption: Leo loves loudly and generously, and they want the whole room to know you are theirs. They give big affection and expect a little applause back. Would you listen to the Leo playlist?

posts.text:
chat is this real

a leo just said "i don't care what people think"

then posted the same selfie 3 times to see who viewed it

the lore is undefeated
posts.caption: Leo is a fixed fire sign that thrives on recognition, even when they swear they are above it. The confidence is real, and so is the story view count. Is your Leo checking who watched?

posts.text:
leo aura report

walking in like a movie trailer: +5000 aura
tripping on the step: -1000 aura
turning the trip into a bit and getting applause: +10000 aura

leos don't lose aura. they remix it
posts.caption: Leo has a natural gift for performance, so even an embarrassing moment becomes part of the show. Their charisma turns mistakes into highlights. What is the best Leo recovery you have ever witnessed?

posts.text:
virgo locked in levels

level 1: color coded calendar
level 2: color coded calendar for the calendar
level 3: fixing your calendar while you sleep

they're not glazing your planning skills. they're replacing them
posts.caption: Virgo is the mutable earth sign of order and precision, ruled by detail-obsessed Mercury. They show love by quietly fixing the things you keep putting off. Has a Virgo ever reorganized your life without asking?

posts.text:
pov: you asked a virgo for "just a quick opinion"

they sent a 9 slide deck
with footnotes
and a section titled "concerns"

you're not cooked. you're being saved. there's a difference
posts.caption: Virgo feedback is thorough, specific and annoyingly correct, because analysis is how they care. They would rather over-help than watch you struggle. What did your Virgo friend critique last?

posts.text:
virgo crashing out looks like

quietly re-alphabetizing the spice rack at 1am

no yelling. no tears. just cumin before garlic

the most peaceful crash out you will ever witness
posts.caption: When Virgos are stressed, they do not explode, they organize. Creating order is how their busy Mercury minds calm down. What do you clean when you are spiraling?

posts.text:
virgo moon vs npcs

npc: "we'll figure it out when we get there"
virgo moon: already figured it out, booked it, packed snacks, and made a backup plan for the backup plan

sorry for being the only one with a save file
posts.caption: A Virgo moon finds emotional safety in preparation, so spontaneity feels like an unsolved puzzle. They are the friend with band-aids, chargers and a plan B. Are you the planner in your friend group?

posts.text:
chat is this real

a libra has been picking a restaurant for 52 minutes

read every review
asked 4 friends

picked the first one they said. we are so back
posts.caption: Libra is the cardinal air sign of balance, so every decision gets weighed from every angle. The process is chaos, but the final answer is usually right. How long does your Libra take to pick dinner?

posts.text:
libra rizz tier list

s tier: eye contact like you're in a rom com
a tier: remembering your favorite color
b tier: agreeing with everything you say
f tier: answering "what do you want to eat" (impossible)
posts.caption: Libra is ruled by Venus, so charm, beauty and romance come naturally to them. Just do not ask them to make a choice under pressure. What is the best Libra flirting move you have seen?

posts.text:
libra lore drop

has never lost an argument
has never started one
will mediate yours for free

the real side quest is getting them to pick a side
posts.caption: Libra carries the scales, so fairness and harmony matter more to them than being right. They are the friend group's unpaid peacekeeper. Have you ever gotten a Libra to actually take your side?

posts.text:
venus in libra aura scoring

matching the outfit to the restaurant: +2000 aura
changing outfits 3 times: +0 aura (neutral. balanced)
saying "i don't mind" for the 9th time: -1000 aura

the scales are scaling
posts.caption: Venus is at home in Libra, which gives these placements impeccable taste and a deep fear of inconveniencing anyone. They look perfect and still will not pick the movie. Is your Venus in Libra this polite?

posts.text:
scorpio lore drop

knows your ex's cousin's dog's name
has never followed you
will never explain how they know

the lore is classified. you don't have clearance
posts.caption: Scorpio is a fixed water sign ruled by Pluto, the planet of secrets, so research is basically their cardio. They know everything and reveal nothing. What has a Scorpio somehow known about you?

posts.text:
pov: a scorpio said "interesting" after you told them a secret

that was not a reaction
that was a file being opened

it will come up in 2031. calmly. and they will win
posts.caption: Scorpio placements listen more than they speak, and their memory is a locked vault. Nothing you say is ever truly forgotten, just stored. What has a Scorpio brought up years later?

posts.text:
scorpio moon aura report

saying 9 words all night: +3000 aura
all 9 were devastating: +5000 aura
accidentally liking your story from 2022: -1000 aura

(they will act like it never happened. so will you)
posts.caption: A Scorpio moon is private, observant and famously mysterious, until one accidental like blows their cover. Their quiet intensity is the whole appeal. Has a Scorpio ever deep liked your old posts?

posts.text:
you're cooked if a scorpio says

"no it's fine"
"i'm not mad"
"do whatever you want"

you're safe if a scorpio says

""

(silence means they're planning your birthday surprise)
posts.caption: Scorpio is all-or-nothing, so their calm words can mean a storm and their silence can mean devotion. They love with total focus, including secret planning. Can you tell when your Scorpio is actually mad?

posts.text:
sagittarius side quest log

went out for coffee
ended up at a pottery class in another city
made 3 new best friends
never got the coffee

main quest: abandoned. side quests: legendary
posts.caption: Sagittarius is the mutable fire sign ruled by Jupiter, the planet of adventure and luck. They never stick to the plan, and somehow the detour is always better. What is the wildest side quest a Sag has taken you on?

posts.text:
chat is this real

a sagittarius just told their friend's new date "i give it two months"

at dinner

out loud

they were right. they're always right. that's the worst part
posts.caption: Sagittarius is the zodiac's truth teller, honest to the point of accidental chaos. Their bluntness comes from optimism, not malice, but it still stings. What is the most brutal truth a Sag has told you?

posts.text:
sagittarius rizz tier list

s tier: making you laugh until you choke on your drink
a tier: inviting you on a road trip on date 1
b tier: actually going on the road trip
f tier: making plans for next weekend (too far away)
posts.caption: Sagittarius flirts with humor and spontaneity, so dating them feels like a travel vlog. Freedom matters more to them than planning ahead. Would you say yes to a first date road trip?

posts.text:
sagittarius crashing out when someone says "let's just stay in"

friday. 9pm. they're pacing. they've opened 4 flight apps.

the crash out is literally just a vacation
posts.caption: Sagittarius needs movement, novelty and open roads, so a quiet weekend feels like a cage. Jupiter makes them restless in the most fun way. Is your Sag already planning an escape?

posts.text:
capricorn has been locked in since birth

age 7: lemonade stand business plan
age 15: 5 year plan
age 25: still on schedule

the lore is just a spreadsheet and they're winning
posts.caption: Capricorn is the cardinal earth sign ruled by Saturn, the planet of discipline and long-term goals. They were born with a planner in hand and they actually use it. What was your Capricorn's first business?

posts.text:
capricorn rizz tier list

s tier: remembering your goals and asking about them
a tier: sending you a linkedin article
b tier: replying "noted" to your paragraph
f tier: saying "i love you" before the 6 month review
posts.caption: Capricorn flirts through reliability, ambition and showing up exactly when they said they would. Romance runs on a timeline, but once they commit, it is permanent. Would a LinkedIn article win you over?

posts.text:
capricorn moon aura scoring

answering emails on vacation: -1000 aura
answering them from a beach chair in a nice coat: +3000 aura
taking a real day off: error. aura not found
posts.caption: A Capricorn moon feels safest when they are being productive, so true rest feels almost suspicious. They are working on it, probably with a schedule. When was your last real day off?

posts.text:
chat is this real

a capricorn said "i'm taking the day off"

they reorganized their closet
updated their resume
and meal prepped for 3 weeks

this is what rest looks like for them. respect it
posts.caption: Capricorns define relaxation as finally getting to the tasks nobody assigned them. Saturn keeps them disciplined, even on a Saturday. What does your Capricorn do on a day off?

posts.text:
aquarius at the party

everyone else: small talk
aquarius: "do you think octopuses have dreams"

not an npc. never was. they're on a completely different server
posts.caption: Aquarius is the fixed air sign ruled by Uranus, so their mind runs on big questions and odd facts. Small talk bores them, but deep tangents light them up. What random question has an Aquarius asked you?

posts.text:
aquarius lore drop

loves humanity
left you on read for 9 days
was researching ancient roman plumbing
will explain it to you for 2 hours

not cooked. just on a side quest
posts.caption: Aquarius cares about the whole world and somehow forgets to text back, because their brain is busy with something fascinating. Detached does not mean uncaring. What is your Aquarius researching right now?

posts.text:
aquarius aura report

wearing something weird on purpose: +3000 aura
everyone copying it 6 months later: +10000 aura
saying "i did it first": -1000 aura (but they did)
posts.caption: Aquarius is the zodiac's trendsetter, always ahead of the curve and slightly misunderstood until everyone catches up. Originality is their whole brand. What trend did your Aquarius start first?

posts.text:
pov: you're trying to understand an aquarius moon

they care about you deeply
they will not say it
they'll send you a 40 minute documentary instead

that's the love language. press play
posts.caption: An Aquarius moon expresses feelings through ideas, sharing what fascinates them instead of saying it outright. If they send you a long video, it means you matter. What has an Aquarius sent you instead of saying I miss you?

posts.text:
pisces sun is delulu and it's working

manifested a parking spot: real
manifested a free coffee: real
manifested their crush texting back: (loading)

chat, the universe is cooking
posts.caption: Pisces is the mutable water sign ruled by Neptune, the planet of dreams, so manifesting is basically their cardio. Their optimism sounds delusional until it works. What have you manifested lately?

posts.text:
pisces crash out vibes

put on a sad playlist
stared out a rainy window
wrote a poem
cried about the poem

felt amazing after. that wasn't a crash out. that was a full movie
posts.caption: Pisces processes big emotions through art, music and a little bit of drama, and it genuinely helps. Neptune turns every feeling into a soundtrack. What is on your Pisces sad playlist?

posts.text:
pisces moon aura scoring

knowing what you feel before you do: +5000 aura
getting lost in the same mall for the 6th time: -1000 aura
finding a cute bookstore while lost: +2000 aura
posts.caption: A Pisces moon is deeply intuitive about people and famously vague about directions. They might get lost, but they always find something magical on the way. Is your Pisces the one who always gets lost?

posts.text:
pov: you vented to a pisces for 5 minutes

they're crying
they're crying harder than you
now you're comforting them

somehow you both feel better. the empath lore is real
posts.caption: Pisces is the most empathic sign in the zodiac, soaking up other people's feelings like a sponge. It sounds chaotic, but being felt that deeply is healing. Who is the Pisces you vent to?
